title: fix: record where a sign-in came from when it is not one of our pages
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
58% of production sign-in starts carry no page. `referringPage` only recognised our own routes, so every other origin collapsed into one opaque bucket — the largest single group in the funnel.

- Records `referrer_host` on `sign_in_started` and `checkout_started`, so external origins are visible instead of empty.
- Stops crediting an external site whose path collides with one of ours: `pollinations.ai/` was attributed to our `/` route.
- Our origin now comes from `BETTER_AUTH_URL` (Better Auth's own `baseURL`), not the request `Host`. workerd omits `Host`, so a Host check passes at the edge while being silently inert in tests — the same divergence behind the 415 beacon bug in #15155.
- Adds a regression test that fails without the origin check.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

gist.headline: The trail gets footprints
gist.blurb: The hive can now tell which outside gardens send visitors its way. Sign-ins and checkouts leave a useful little trail instead of disappearing into the fog.
gist.summary: Product analytics now records `referrer_host` for `sign_in_started` and `checkout_started`, uses `BETTER_AUTH_URL` to reliably identify Pollinations’ own origin, and prevents external URLs with matching paths from being attributed to internal routes.
gist.impact: The funnel can now distinguish external sign-in and checkout origins—including the 58% of production sign-ins with no recognized internal page—while correctly keeping lookalike paths such as an external `pollinations.ai/` URL out of the internal `/` bucket.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy garden-path attribution scene: Polli, wearing a tiny surveyor hat and carrying a clipboard, follows several labeled trail markers from outside gardens toward a glowing sign-in gate. A retro CRT monitor robot sorts the trails by their host names, while distinct flower paths prevent two identical-looking route signs from being confused; this represents recording external referrer hosts and correctly identifying the home origin.
